```
['run a Quart websocket server on port 5000 for playing Hanabi with an AI bot partner', 'create a websocket endpoint at /connect that streams Hanabi game state and accepts player moves', 'build a function to format Hanabi moves into human-readable strings for play, discard, and hint actions', 'test the CYCLE_BOTS environment variable to rotate between multiple Hanabi bot configurations across games', 'review the REPLAY action handler that ends the current game and starts a new one with an optional seed']
```
